response.original_title: Whites-Only Suburbs: How the New Deal Shut Out Black Homebuyers
response.overview: Examines how race-based federal lending rules from New Deal programs in the 1930s kept Black families locked out of suburban neighborhoods, a policy that continues to slow their economic mobility.
